components.rect_policy: Measured actual isolated component bboxes plus4px soft-edge padding. Original generated atlas retained; no repack or repaint.

socket_notes: Socket centers are initial manual measurements as normalized fractions of each actual solid component bbox. Pixel anchors are computed from these and retained in final maps; website calibration owns final binds. Grounded sole/tarsus tips are measured from the component alpha at its lowest solid tip, never from midstrut.
render_alignment: Rigid socket axis aligns via local pivot/end to bindPivot/bindEnd using uniform scale+rotation. Core alignAxis=false. Grounded feet use separate contact matrix and solid sole pivot; Chime tips follow their lower bone with no contact. Website worker calibrates final bind sizes/actions.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, production rigid 2D skeletal game-animation sprite atlas.
Image1 is the CURRENT APPROVED illustrated character: preserve its exact industrial design, anatomy, panel identities, colors, softly sculpted hand-painted lighting and THREE-QUARTER camera. Image2 is actual production in-engine anatomy reference only; ignore all background machines/architecture and printed markings. Do NOT create a different species or kit.
Create ONE component atlas, NOT a pose sheet, NOT complete character repeats, and NOT an exploded character placed together. Each instructed cell contains ONE isolated rigid piece ONLY. All components use matching source camera/foreshortening, light direction, cream ceramic paint wear, marigold fittings, dark ink-navy steel, graphite cables and source optical colors. No organic flesh, vines, fur, magic, alien membranes or unrelated franchise imagery.
Make honest ROUND OVERLAPPING metal sockets at proximal and distal link ends; extend fully painted hidden surfaces behind hinges so rotation never reveals holes. The core must be a CONTINUOUS fully painted bare underlying body with complete hidden armor/cable surfaces and covered attachment sockets, NO baked silhouette/stump of any separately listed appendage. Moving appendage hoses belong to their moving link and terminate at its socket. Body-owned dorsal cables can stay with core as specified.
All isolated parts must be fully framed, with comfortable transparent gutters and no component overlapping another. Preserve neutral bind-direction from source if possible; isolated component scale can vary by cell and renderer will map it back to original bind size.
TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA everywhere outside parts: NO backdrop, black rectangle, ground, shadow, cell borders, grid lines, captions, letters, labels, arrows, numbers, emblems, logos or decals. The names below are instructions ONLY and must NEVER appear in pixels.

CHARACTER IDENTITY: Chime is the exact flying industrial drone in Image1: compact forward cream armored core, central cyan/violet optical lens with four small satellites, dark manufactured chassis and exactly TWO layered articulated wing assemblies. Wing root connects to body, upper/lower vanes attach to the spar at visible mechanical hinges.

necessary_separation_correction.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, precise atlas repair for rigid 2D skeletal animation.
Image1 is the generated Chime 5×5 transparent component atlas. Image2 is its exact approved full character. Keep the ENTIRE atlas's original core, all six wing pieces, the lower links, feet, colors, camera, material detail, proportions, transparent alpha and grid layout unchanged.
Change ONLY these SIX upper tucked-leg pieces in their existing cells: row2/column3 (cell8), row3/column1 (cell11), row3/column4 (cell14), row4/column2 (cell17), row4/column5 (cell20), row5/column3 (cell23). Their current forms incorrectly include a lower strut and pointed toe. Replace each of these six upper-leg sprites with ONLY ONE clean short hip-to-knee dark alloy mechanical link, its source small marigold collar accents, and TWO ROUND OVERLAPPING COVERED SOCKETS, one at EACH end. The upper link must stop at the round knee socket; NO bend continuing into a lower leg, NO lower strut or amber lower-leg armor, NO pointed toe/foot on the upper part, no complete leg. They are six short rigid upper mechanical bone links, not full limbs. Preserve their perspective and source manufacturing detail.
All other 19 component cells must remain intact. In particular do not alter the proper independent lower-leg pieces in row2/column4,row3/column2,row3/column5,row4/column3,row5/column1,row5/column4, or the independent pointed foot/tarsus pieces in row2/column5,row3/column3,row4/column1,row4/column4,row5/column2,row5/column5. Exactly25 separate components, one per occupied cell, 5columns×5rows regular grid, true transparent gutters, no writing/labels/grid marks/backdrop or shadows. This is entirely a manufactured industrial drone, no biological material.
